nodes.name: New Hire Form Submission
nodes.notes: Triggered when a new hire form is submitted via Google Forms, Typeform, or HRIS webhook

nodes.name: Validate Required Fields
nodes.notes: Check for required fields before sending to AI extraction

parameters.name: messages
parameters.value:
=[{"role":"system","content":"You are an onboarding data extraction and normalization assistant. Extract and standardize employee intake data. Return only valid JSON with no markdown formatting or code fences."},{"role":"user","content":"Extract and normalize the following employee intake record. Standardize dates to ISO 8601, normalize names to Title Case, expand department abbreviations, ensure employment_type is one of: full-time, part-time, contractor, intern. Set review_required to true if any required field is missing or any issue is found. Return only valid JSON.

Raw intake data:
" + JSON.stringify($json.raw_data)}]

nodes.name: AI Extract and Normalize
nodes.notes: Sends raw intake data to OpenAI GPT-4o for extraction, normalization, and validation

nodes.name: Parse AI Response
nodes.notes: Safely parses the JSON response from OpenAI

nodes.name: Data Complete?
nodes.notes: Routes to manual review if AI flags incomplete or problematic data

nodes.name: Create Onboarding Record
nodes.notes: Creates the canonical onboarding record in Airtable with status In Progress

parameters.name: messages
parameters.value:
=[{"role":"system","content":"You are a professional onboarding coordinator. Generate personalized, role-specific onboarding plans and task lists. Return only valid JSON."},{"role":"user","content":"Based on this employee profile, generate two things:
1. A personalized 30-day onboarding plan
2. A list of onboarding tasks with assigned team and due date offset

Return JSON with keys: onboarding_plan (with welcome_message, day_1, week_1_priorities, key_contacts, required_training, first_30_day_goals) and tasks (array with task_title, assigned_team, priority, due_date_offset, description).

Employee profile:
" + JSON.stringify($json)}]

nodes.name: Generate Onboarding Plan and Tasks
nodes.notes: Generates a personalized 30-day onboarding plan and task list using GPT-4o

nodes.name: Parse Plan and Tasks
nodes.notes: Parses the AI-generated onboarding plan and task list

parameters.name: messages
parameters.value:
=[{"role":"system","content":"You are an HR communications specialist. Write professional, warm, personalized employee communications. Return only valid JSON."},{"role":"user","content":"Write two communications:
1. A welcome email to the new hire
2. A manager handoff brief

Return JSON with: welcome_email (subject, body) and manager_brief (subject, body). Use \n for line breaks in body fields.

Employee details:
" + JSON.stringify($json.employee) + "

Onboarding plan:
" + JSON.stringify($json.onboarding_plan)}]

nodes.name: Draft Communications
nodes.notes: Generates personalized welcome email and manager brief using GPT-4o

nodes.name: Merge All Data
nodes.notes: Merges employee data, plan, tasks, and drafted communications into a single object

nodes.name: Send Welcome Email
nodes.notes: Sends personalized welcome email to the new hire

nodes.name: Send Manager Brief
nodes.notes: Sends manager handoff brief with onboarding summary and action items

nodes.name: Notify HR Slack Channel
nodes.notes: Posts onboarding summary to the HR Slack channel

nodes.name: Update Onboarding Status
nodes.notes: Updates the Airtable record with generated plan, task count, and communication flags

parameters.responseBody: ={"status":"success","message":"Onboarding initiated for " + $('Merge All Data').first().json.employee['Full Name'],"tasks_created":$('Merge All Data').first().json.tasks.length}

nodes.name: Respond Success
nodes.notes: Returns success response to the originating form trigger

parameters.subject: Action Required: Complete Your Onboarding Form
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $('Validate Required Fields').first().json.raw_data.full_name || 'New Team Member' }},

Thank you for starting your onboarding. We noticed some required information is missing from your submission.

Missing fields: {{ $('Validate Required Fields').first().json.missing_fields.join(', ') }}

Please resubmit the form with the missing information so we can complete your onboarding setup before your start date.

If you have any questions, please reply to this email.

Best regards,
People Operations Team

nodes.name: Request Missing Info
nodes.notes: Emails the candidate when required fields are missing from the form submission

parameters.responseBody: ={"status":"incomplete","message":"Missing required fields. Email sent requesting completion.","missing_fields":$('Validate Required Fields').first().json.missing_fields}

nodes.name: Respond Incomplete
nodes.notes: Returns incomplete status when required fields are missing

meta.description: AI-powered enterprise onboarding automation. Receives new hire form submissions, extracts and validates data using GPT-4o, creates Airtable records, generates personalized onboarding plans and tasks, and sends automated communications to new hires, managers, and HR.
